<a id="google-calendar-api"></a>
### Google Calendar API v3

`googleapis (npm) · calendar v3` · library · **recommended** · phases: Build

Official API for two-way sync with the client’s Google calendar: events, free/busy, sync tokens, push channels and Meet links.

**Use when**
- CRM meetings must appear in the client’s real calendar
- Creating events with a Google Meet link

**Avoid when**
- Read-only sharing; an ICS feed is simpler
- Calling it from the browser with secrets

**How to use**
- OAuth with calendar.events scope; store refresh tokens encrypted server-side
- Initial list, then incremental sync with syncToken
- events.watch push channel to a webhook route: no polling
- conferenceData.createRequest for Meet links

**Pairs with:** [Google Calendar connector](calendar.md#google-calendar) · [ICS & recurrence (ical-generator, ical.js, rrule)](calendar.md#ics-tools) · [Calendar hub](calendar.md#calendar-hub)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/calendars/01-integration-playbook.md](../../docs/calendars/01-integration-playbook.md)

**Requires:** Google Cloud project with Calendar API enabled

**Docs:** https://developers.google.com/calendar/api/guides/overview

<a id="google-calendar"></a>
### Google Calendar connector

`Google Calendar MCP` · connector · **recommended** · phases: Build

Hosted Google Calendar connector for the agent: list, search, create and update events, suggest times.

**Use when**
- The agent should read the week, find a slot or draft an event
- Building and testing calendar features during development

**Avoid when**
- Product code: the deployed app uses the Calendar API, not the agent connector

**How to use**
- Read first (list_events, suggest_time); write only after the human approves

**Pairs with:** [Schedule Meeting](calendar.md#schedule-meeting) · [Google Calendar API v3](calendar.md#google-calendar-api) · [Google Calendar MCP (open source)](calendar.md#google-calendar-mcp)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/calendars/01-integration-playbook.md#agents](../../docs/calendars/01-integration-playbook.md#agents)

**Requires:** Google account

<a id="ics-tools"></a>
### ICS & recurrence (ical-generator, ical.js, rrule)

`npm i ical-generator ical.js rrule` · library · **recommended** · phases: Build

Subscribe links, Add-to-calendar files, ICS import and repeat rules without a provider account.

**Use when**
- Add to calendar buttons or a private subscribe feed
- Repeating follow-ups stored as an RRULE

**Avoid when**
- Two-way sync; use the provider API

**How to use**
- Stable UID per event so updates replace, not duplicate
- Store the rule, expand only the visible range
- Feed URLs carry a long random token; revoke by rotating it

**Pairs with:** [Google Calendar API v3](calendar.md#google-calendar-api) · [Calendar hub](calendar.md#calendar-hub)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/calendars/01-integration-playbook.md#ics](../../docs/calendars/01-integration-playbook.md#ics)

**Docs:** https://github.com/sebbo2002/ical-generator

<a id="shadcn-calendar"></a>
### shadcn Calendar (React DayPicker)

`npx shadcn@latest add calendar` · library · **recommended** · phases: Build

Accessible date and range picker that already reads the toolkit’s shadcn token mapping.

**Use when**
- Any date or range input
- A mini month on a dashboard

**Avoid when**
- Week/day scheduling with drag; use FullCalendar or Schedule-X

**How to use**
- Add via shadcn CLI; tokens map through tailwind.preset.js
- mode="range" for report filters; disabled for invalid dates

**Pairs with:** [Calendar hub](calendar.md#calendar-hub)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/calendars/02-calendar-ui-rules.md](../../docs/calendars/02-calendar-ui-rules.md)

**Docs:** https://daypicker.dev

<a id="fullcalendar"></a>
### FullCalendar

`@fullcalendar/react` · library · **optional** · phases: Build

Full month/week/day/list scheduler with drag and drop, Google and ICS sources. MIT core, paid resource views.

**Use when**
- A full scheduling screen in a web app

**Avoid when**
- A simple agenda card; build it from tokens
- Resource timelines without budget for the premium license

**How to use**
- Theme via --fc-* CSS variables set from tokens
- eventSources as a function for the visible range; refetch on change, not on a timer

**Pairs with:** [Google Calendar API v3](calendar.md#google-calendar-api) · [ICS & recurrence (ical-generator, ical.js, rrule)](calendar.md#ics-tools)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/calendars/02-calendar-ui-rules.md](../../docs/calendars/02-calendar-ui-rules.md)

**Docs:** https://fullcalendar.io

### Google Calendar MCP (open source)

`github.com/nspady/google-calendar-mcp` · connector · **optional** · phases: Build

Self-hosted MCP server: multi-account calendars, conflict detection, free/busy and recurring edits for an AI assistant.

**Use when**
- Several Google accounts need checking at once
- The hosted connector is not available

**Avoid when**
- The hosted Google Calendar connector already covers the task
- Writes without a human approval step

**How to use**
- Google Cloud project + Desktop OAuth client
- Add to MCP config; start read-only

<a id="gcalcli"></a>
### gcalcli

`gcalcli (pipx)` · cli · **situational** · phases: Build, Polish & QA

Google Calendar from the terminal: agenda, search, quick-add, ICS import. Handy for seeding test events.

**Use when**

**Avoid when**

**How to use**
